name: Mune Kyun! Heart de Koi Shi-te-ru ~Onii-chan Motto Daisuki~
original_name: 胸キュン！はぁとde恋シ・テ・ル～お兄ちゃんもっと大好き～
source:
One day, a letter with just one world "marriage" from comes from Yuta's father. Upon returning to home town Yuta does not find his father in the shrine. Instead, there are three childhood friend girls. It turns out that father's new wife is mother of these three girls. Now Yuta is stuck in the shrine with three new cute sisters while parents are on marriage voyage...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，优太收到父亲寄来的信，信上只有‘结婚’两个字。回到故乡后，优太没有在神社见到父亲，反而遇见了3位青梅竹马。原来，父亲的新婚妻子正是这3名女孩的母亲。父母踏上蜜月旅行后，优太只得与3位新来的可爱姐妹一同留在神社…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
